dog.description_text: Jules is a beautiful three-year-old female who was found as a resourceful stray in Queens. While she has a resilient spirit from her time on the streets, she is ready to trade the pavement for a cozy lap and a forever family. She is incredibly friendly once she gets to know you and, as a slightly more mature girl, she has a wonderful balance of calm affection and loyal companionship that will bring so much warmth to your home.
dog.name: Jules
